posts.description: This post is about overcoming fear as a writer or solopreneur. This post won’t let you off the hook. posts.title: Forget LinkedIn, Substack. Your own site should be your online HQ
posts.description: Freelance writers need their own websites. Solopreneurs and independent contractors need their own sites. The same protocol applies to gig workers and hobbyists with a side hustle.
